_meta.description: Deep-time validation anchors: published paleontological / cyclostratigraphic measurements vs the model's proper-physics two-layer predictions (Phase 19 dossier). OBSERVED values are verbatim from the cited sources (as tabulated in docs/99 §'Validation against published paleontological measurements'); the model predictions are NOT stored here — tools/verify/paleo-anchors.js recomputes them live from the engine and asserts each expectation. Documented deviations (Williams 620 Ma, the Wu Pangea interval) are encoded as deviation BANDS: the gate fails on an unexplained IMPROVEMENT too (verify-laws precedent — a suddenly-matching miss means the formula changed).

recipes.moonDistanceRE: meanMoonDistanceCorrectedAtAge(ageMa) / earthParallaxRadiusKm (raw meanMoonDistanceAtAge for the Hadean row — the solar-Δa correction is a modern-orbit construct)

expectationTypes.range: predicted inside [lo, hi], allowing outsideToleranceAbs beyond either edge
expectationTypes.deviationBandPct: (predicted/observed - 1) * 100 inside band [lo, hi] — a DOCUMENTED deviation that must persist
expectationTypes.deviationBandOutsideRange: signed distance outside the observed range (positive above hi, negative below lo) inside band [lo, hi]

sources.wells1963: Wells, J.W. 1963. Coral growth and geochronometry. Nature 197, 948–950 (table via Arbab 2001 review)
sources.winter2020: de Winter et al. 2020. Subdaily-scale chemical variability in a Torreites sanchezi rudist shell. Paleoceanography and Paleoclimatology 35, e2019PA003723
sources.pannella1972: Pannella 1972 / Scrutton — bivalve growth increments, ~90 Ma
sources.williams2000: Williams, G.E. 2000. Geological constraints on the Precambrian history of Earth's rotation. Rev. Geophys. 38, 37–59 (Elatina tidal rhythmites)
sources.mitchellKirscher2023: Mitchell, R.N. & Kirscher, U. 2023. Mid-Proterozoic day length stalled by tidal resonance. Nature Geoscience 16, 567–569
sources.wu2024: Wu, Malinverno, Meyers, et al. 2024. A 650-Myr history of Earth's axial precession frequency... Science Advances, doi:10.1126/sciadv.ado2412
sources.patterson1956: Patterson, C. 1956. Age of meteorites and the earth. Geochim. Cosmochim. Acta 10, 230–237 (Pb–Pb age → giant-impact epoch consistency)
sources.farhat2022: Farhat, Auclair-Desrotour, Boué & Laskar 2022. The resonant tidal evolution of the Earth-Moon distance. A&A 665, L1 (arXiv 2207.00438). Proxy anchors from their Tables 2-3: Joffre cyclostratigraphy, Weeli Wolli tidal rhythmites, Moodies Group tidal bundles
sources.zhou2024: Zhou et al. 2024. Earth-Moon dynamics from cyclostratigraphy reveals possible ocean tide resonance in the Mesoproterozoic era. Science Advances, doi:10.1126/sciadv.adn7674 (Table S3: paired a+LOD at Chuanlinggou/Wumishan/Yemahe)
sources.meyersMalinverno2018: Meyers & Malinverno 2018. Proterozoic Milankovitch cycles and the history of the solar system. PNAS, doi:10.1073/pnas.1717689115 (Xiamaling Formation)
sources.nanfen2023: Length of day at c. 1.1 Ga based on cyclostratigraphic analyses of the Nanfen Formation. J. Geol. Soc. 180, doi:10.1144/jgs2022-022
